prompt:
A desktop marketing landing page for White Sail Labs, an independent market research lab, rendered edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is an investor, CEO or strategist deciding whether to request early access. White Sail Labs sells research as a subscription: applied AI engineers and business engineers build an always-on fleet of agents that keeps a living world model of every company; when a fact arrives, only the surprise travels along the value chain.

The page IS a synoptic pressure chart, edge to edge, fine navy isobars under everything. A slim navy band at the very top carries a cream sail silhouette with three short speed lines beside the wordmark White Sail Labs, and the navigation Who we are, Capabilities, Careers, Contact.

What leads is the headline printed as the chart's own title, enormous, spanning most of the width across the top of the chart: "Your decisions. Better informed." Beside its end, small: "A research lab of people and agents, not an AI tool." with Request early access and Get in touch.

Under the title, a numbered ripple crosses the full width, tagged Illustrative: 1 SK hynix (HBM output guidance +20% vs +12% expected, surprise +8 pts) sends a thick gold front with semicircles to 2 NVIDIA (GPU shipments forecast +3.2%), which sends thinner gold fronts to 3a Microsoft (AI capacity +1.1%) and 3b Meta (capex +0.9%) and a thin navy front with triangles to 4 Samsung (HBM share −0.6 pts).

Along the bottom, the chart's key strip opens the next section, headed "Key · Who we are", with three legend entries each beside its own chart symbol: Applied AI Engineers, Business Engineers, Always-on Agents Fleet.

Visual law: crisp off-white chart ground, deep navy and warm gold as the only two inks, no red; station plots, front symbols and a ruled key as the signature; labels in a clear technical grotesk. One dominant move: the giant printed title over the ripple.
note: The Who we are descriptions in the key were invented by the render; the build uses the approved team copy.
